clock_contract: Same-host Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC; CUDA intervals mapped approximately using rank anchor bracket.
coverage: All prefill; sampled decode only. Missing stages remain missing. Parallel ranks are never summed.
interpretation: Observed instrumented intervals and overlap; no causal attribution. CUDA stream spans include waits and launch starvation; routed spans include dispatch/combine.
totals_scope: Full recorded trace unless labeled approximate_window; CUDA mapping uses anchor midpoint. Model minus routed union subtracts summed direct durations of sequential nonoverlapping routed slots from direct model duration; it includes waits and launch starvation and may have small signed event rounding error. Anchor offsets are approximate and used only for window clipping and overlap.
